column1: # Purpose: choose automatic update behavior independently for each Mise tool.
# Format: TOOL<TAB>POLICY, exactly two nonempty fields separated by one literal TAB.
# TOOL: exact key from [tools] in dotfiles/mise/.config/mise/config.toml; no version suffix.
# POLICY: latest refreshes the native lock before apply; installed only ensures the locked version exists.
# Version constraints still apply: exact runtime pins and Trust Holds are never widened.
# Tools omitted from this file default to installed. Duplicate or unknown tools are errors.
# Blank lines and whole-line # comments are allowed; inline comments, spaces as separators and CRLF are not.
# Maintenance: change one policy; keep versions and backend options in the native Mise config.
# Example: npm:@openai/codex<TAB>latest (replace <TAB> with one literal TAB).
